# Repertoire

Repertoire automates installation and lifecycle management for portable
SKILL.md packages across AI coding agents. Skills install to home-directory
agent roots by default; use --project for Git worktree installs.

Documentation: https://phillarmonic.github.io/repertoire-ai/
Automation guide: https://phillarmonic.github.io/repertoire-ai/automation/
Commands: https://phillarmonic.github.io/repertoire-ai/commands/
Supported targets: https://phillarmonic.github.io/repertoire-ai/concepts/targets-security/
GitHub: https://github.com/phillarmonic/repertoire-ai
